title: Remembered the soaking tubs this morning.
content: Has anyone been to somewhat luxurious soaking tubs? This morning after a totally separate dream, I recalled one of the few “proper” mall world dreams I’ve had/remembered in which I return to a hair salon/spa place for “self care”, which I weirdly never have time for or seek out in waking life, so why the fuck I’m there I have no idea. The salon contains the entrance to a zone with elaborately formed soaking areas consisting of many square, acrylic, onsen-like tubs and weird water features delivering water, and few walls. They’re lovely and not populated and I want to stay, but often can’t get a room for very long or have to leave. I’m pretty sure the salon also contains an entrance to my version of the “filthy bathroom” or locker room other folks have experienced. Is this familiar for anyone else?
